handoff: GR6b review: all ACs met with tests (decide rule + negatives, rule case, S1 close/reopen/round 2); unit, typecheck and slice integration green. One minor: failed mailbox ref deletes not reported.

findings.title: A failed mailbox ref deletion is silently dropped
findings.detail:
closeClosedIssueStory collects only the refs whose deleteMailbox succeeded; a failed one is not reported in the result's error or detail, and since the story is in act.cleaned and its claim is gone, nothing retries it. A stale refs/norn/inbox/<story>/… ref can be left behind without a trace of why.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add the failed refs and their reasons to detail (e.g. mailbox_failed: [{ref, reason}]) so the trace shows it.
